messages:
deploy-bot: Hotfix rollout requested for service `embeddings-eu1` -> prod-eu1. Patch: reduce KV cache pressure after recent quant change. Change window: immediate (10m prep). Owner: nina. Runbook: <https://go/internal/runbooks/embeds-kvcache>|runbook

nina: TL;DR: memory spike + K/V churn caused transient 503s. Patch drops cache size and tweaks eviction; validated in staging. Need expedited ops lane.

leo: Ack. What are rollback steps? Need ops-lead to confirm.

ops-lead: Rollback command (tested in staging):
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/embeds-eu --to-revision=3
# then scale down new RC and restore previous replicas
```
Canary requirement: >=2 approvers + ops-lead signoff.

sarah: +1 for expedite provided we keep canary at 5-10% for 15m with alerts on. I'll watch latency and 5xx. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Expedited approval flow: react with :thumbsup: to approve. Auto-apply in 5m if 2 approvals (excluding deploy-bot).

mike: :thumbsup: +1

jen: :thumbsup: +1 — I'll be pager on-duty for 20m post-deploy and will escalate on any >2% error rate.

deploy-bot: Approval threshold reached (2 approvals + ops-lead consent). Starting canary rollout now.

deploy-bot: Rolling out:
```
Image: registry.redwood/embeds:hotfix-kv-2026-03-23
Canary -> 10% traffic to pool-eu-canary
Nodes: node-pool-eu-1
```

nina: Pushing release note draft: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/hotfix-embeds-2026-03-23 — includes root cause, mitigation, rollback cmd.

sarah: Metrics live — 503s dropping from 4.2% -> 0.3% in the canary. Nice. :white_check_mark:

jen: Observability looks good. Recommend bump canary to 50% in 10m and keep on-call pinned.

mike: Agree. Also pin model to `v1.3-quant-safe` during full rollout.

ops-lead: Model pin applied in routing layer. If errors spike >5% in any 5m window, abort and rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 50%. Full rollout scheduled after 20m stable window unless abort.

nina: Thanks everyone — will update release note with final timings + rollback snippet. Leaving thread open for post-rollout verification.

jen: Post-check: 20m after full rollout, 99p latency stable and error rate at 0.2%. Closing watch in 10m. :party_popper:
